name: Rumah Kampung Tawau Homestay
description: A traditional kampung house in the heart of Apas, renovated with modern comforts while keeping its rustic charm. Wake up to birdsong in the garden, enjoy home-cooked local breakfast, and explore the nearby Apas markets on foot. Perfect for families who want an authentic Tawau experience.

name: Sinsuran Townhouse Stay
description: A bright, modern townhouse right in Tawau town centre. Walk to the waterfront, local seafood restaurants, and night markets within minutes. Ideal for travellers who want convenience without giving up space and comfort.

name: Kuhara Garden Homestay
description: A cosy family homestay surrounded by a lush garden in the quiet Kuhara neighbourhood. A popular base for those heading to the caves and plantations, with a shared BBQ corner and plenty of space for kids to run around.

name: Takada Riverside Homestay
address: Kampung Takada, Jalan Takada, 91000 Tawau, Sabah
description: Set along a quiet stretch of river on the outskirts of Tawau, this homestay offers calm mornings, cool breezes, and a covered veranda made for coffee and conversation. Boat trips and jungle walks can be arranged by the owner.

name: Merotai Village Retreat
description: A laid-back village homestay surrounded by oil palm and fruit orchards. Guests are welcomed like family, with guided walks, seasonal fruit tasting, and a rustic outdoor kitchen. A genuine slice of Sabahan village life.

name: Balung River View Homestay
description: A peaceful riverside homestay at the edge of the Balung river valley, about 20 minutes from town. Wake up to mist over the water, enjoy the open-air dining deck, and cool off with an evening swim nearby.
